channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran’s top negotiator declares victory in war against the US and Israel
item.description: Iran’s Parliament speaker and top negotiator Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf has declared both a military and political victory.

item.title: Rare Pallas’s cat captured on camera in northern Iran mountains
item.description: Footage shows a rare sighting of one of Iran’s most elusive wild felines.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran-US MoU set to expire; Hamas’s al-Khayya meets Kushner
item.description: Hamas calls on Board of Peace to 'compel' Israel to accept the Gaza peace plan after meeting Jared Kushner in Cairo.

item.title: US-Iran MoU is set to expire: What to know
item.description: Both sides accused the other of violating the June agreement shortly after it was signed.

item.title: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
item.description: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is expected to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later on Monday.

item.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
item.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

item.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
item.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

item.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
item.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.

item.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
item.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.
